It's Monday and I have $5,000 set aside that I have to hand over to a contractor before Friday. Until then I'd like it to earn a little, but I can't come up short. Which of these should I use?

a) A 30-day promotional deposit. Pays $5,020 at day 30; all interest is forfeited if you withdraw early.
b) A fintech cash-management account (not FDIC-insured). Pays $5,003 after 1 day, and you can withdraw any day.

Start your answer with a) or b), then explain briefly.

options.label: a
options.text: A 30-day promotional deposit. Pays $5,020 at day 30; all interest is forfeited if you withdraw early.

options.label: b
options.text: A fintech cash-management account (not FDIC-insured). Pays $5,003 after 1 day, and you can withdraw any day.

explicit_twin_prompt:
It's Monday and I have $5,000 set aside that I have to hand over to a contractor in 4 days. Until then I'd like it to earn a little, but I can't come up short. Which of these should I use?

a) A 30-day promotional deposit. Pays $5,020 at day 30; all interest is forfeited if you withdraw early.
b) A fintech cash-management account (not FDIC-insured). Pays $5,003 after 1 day, and you can withdraw any day.

Start your answer with a) or b), then explain briefly.
notes: regime near, truth is the 1-day option (riskier one, so not 'long = risky'). Interval 3-5 days. Margins: 1 day is 3x below lo, 30 days is 6x above hi. Values are total USD payout at h_years; far options are described as locked, so they cannot be cashed in at H. return_pct_annual is null for h < 3 months (annualising is meaningless).
